summary: Substantive AI contributions must be disclosed with details and reviewed before opening; open the PR yourself rather than letting a tool do it. The same applies to issues, discussions, comments and AI-assisted reviews.

evidence.quote: If your pull request contains substantive contributions from a generative AI tool, please disclose so with details, and review all changes before opening.
Open the pull request yourself once you have reviewed it, rather than having a tool open it on your behalf.
This also applies to other content, such as issues, discussions, and comments.
AI-assisted review is allowed so long as it is disclosed, but all humans remain responsible for the content they generate.
